test: src/main/agents/agentMailDesktop.test.ts > the central mail monitor: pages, generations and timers > reads in bounded pages with one sweep in flight, and discards a sweep's late results once its folder stops
diagnosis: Temporary log in ChatMailDesk.poll's catch (removed) showed, inside this test, repeated polls failing with '<previous test's temp root>\a is not initialized': monitors created by earlier tests (via snapshot) were never disposed. Their 2 s poll ran on the real clock after their test removed its folder; when one fired during this test, which fakes setTimeout, ChatMailDesk.schedule re-armed it on the fake clock, so the test counted a timer it did not create. Only happens when enough real time passes between tests (load).
fix: The test file records every service watchedMail creates and disposes them all in afterEach, before vi.useRealTimers().
